roles.name: Head of Hiking & Mountaineering
roles.description: Leads the development of hiking and mountaineering activities, from local hikes to more ambitious mountain adventures.

roles.name: Head of Trips & Expeditions
roles.description: Plans and coordinates major trips, including destinations, itineraries, accommodation and participant registration.

roles.name: Hiking & Trail Coordinator
roles.description: Organises regular hikes around Stockholm, selects routes and ensures activities are accessible to different experience levels.

roles.name: Logistics & Equipment Coordinator
roles.description: Manages transportation, equipment rentals and practical arrangements for hikes and expeditions.

roles.name: Head of Finance
roles.description: Oversees budgets, expenses, reimbursements and financial planning for club activities.

roles.name: Partnerships & Sponsorship Manager
roles.description: Develops collaborations with outdoor brands, local organisations and potential sponsors to support club activities.

roles.name: Social Media Manager
roles.description: Promotes club activities, manages social media and creates engaging content to grow the hiking community at SSE.

roles.name: Hiking Photographer & Content Creator
roles.description: Documents hikes and expeditions through photography and video, working alongside the Social Media Manager.
